board.title: Project board
board.subtitle: One card = one product. Drag a card to move it forward.

project.delete_confirm: Delete {{ code }}? Its history and files stay in the library.
project.forced_hint: Straight from "{{ from }}" to "{{ to }}". Leave a reason for the review.

settings.title: Settings
settings.library_hint: Database, images and 3D files all live here, on your own computer.
settings.demo_mode_hint: Every AI call returns a built-in sample and costs nothing. Walk through the pipeline without any keys.
settings.config_readonly: The config file could not be read at startup. To avoid overwriting it, settings will not be saved in this run.
settings.keys_hint: Keys are stored only in this computer's system credential manager. They are never written to config files or uploaded.
settings.key_deepseek_hint: Required. A research run costs roughly ¥0.3–0.5.
settings.key_zhipu_search_hint: Optional, about ¥0.01 per query. Without it, research falls back to your notes plus the model's general knowledge.

lab.no_models: No models yet. Generate a sample, or import your own STL / GLB.

Competitor links, sales and prices you saw, complaints in the comments…
Search engines cannot see inside the platforms, so these are the most valuable evidence.

cad.engine_missing_title: The CAD engine is not installed
cad.engine_missing_hint: Code CAD runs model-written scripts locally with build123d (OpenCascade kernel). In a dev checkout run scripts\setup-cad-engine.ps1; release builds will offer a one-click engine pack here.
cad.engine_installing_title: Preparing the CAD engine (first time only)
cad.engine_installing_hint: The engine ships inside the installer: nothing to download, nothing else to install. Unpacking about {{ mb }} MB, usually around a minute.
cad.engine_unpack_failed_hint: The CAD engine could not be unpacked (low disk space or security software can cause this). Free about 1 GB and press “Check again”. Everything else keeps working.
cad.refs_hint: Product renders, photos or screenshots, up to 4. They are downscaled and stripped of EXIF (location, device) on import, because they are sent to the vision model.
cad.brief_placeholder:
Size, purpose, features that matter…
e.g. 60 mm long, three slots, holds a 5 mm cable
cad.spec_hint: Confirm sizes and features before generating. Fixing the spec is far cheaper than fixing the model.
cad.spec_feature_desc: What it is and where it sits
cad.spec_dims_hint: Dimensions, one per line: name = value
cad.spec_assumptions: Assumed by the model (not visible in the image)
cad.spec_unsuitable: This shape is a poor fit for code CAD: {{ reason }}. Organic shapes are better served by AI mesh generation.
cad.spec_bad_size: The overall size needs three positive numbers (mm)
cad.spec_no_features: The spec needs at least one feature
cad.spec_bad_dim: Cannot read this dimension line: {{ line }} (format: name = value)
cad.demo_note: Demo mode: the spec and scripts are canned, but they run on the real local engine (the first draft carries a deliberate bug to show the repair loop).
cad.step_repairing: Draft {{ attempt }} has {{ problems }} problem(s), repairing…
cad.no_versions: No models yet. Add a reference image, draft the spec and generate — or write a build123d script under “Code” and run it.
cad.code_placeholder: Write or paste a build123d script here (assign the final shape to result)…
cad.params_hint: Edit a number and press Enter: rebuilt locally, no model call, no cost.
cad.no_params: This script declares no adjustable parameters.
cad.edit_placeholder: e.g. make the slot bottoms round; add an M3 hole at each end
cad.edit_hint: Only the relevant feature sections change; everything else stays byte-for-byte. The changed sections are recorded on the new version.
cad.review_hint: Four rendered views are compared with the reference images by the vision model.
cad.review_no_refs: This version has no reference image to compare against.
cad.snapped: The part was snapped onto the build plate (z = 0) automatically
cad.usage: {{ calls }} model call(s) · {{ runs }} run(s) · ¥{{ yuan }} · {{ secs }} s
cad.failed_hint: The last draft is in the Code box and each draft's errors are listed below. Fix it by hand and run, or adjust the spec and retry.
cad.p_timeout: Killed after running for {{ secs }} s
cad.p_solids: The model consists of {{ count }} disconnected solids
cad.p_off_plate: Not sitting on the build plate (lowest z = {{ z }})
cad.p_size: Size differs from the spec: got {{ got }}, spec {{ want }}
cad.p_too_big: Exceeds the build volume: {{ size }} mm
cad.p_param_range: Parameter {{ name }} = {{ value }} is outside its declared range
cad.p_unchanged: The model returned the script unchanged

studio.title: Modeling
studio.subtitle: From an image or a sentence to a parametric 3D model — then refine it with AI, one message at a time.
studio.no_designs: No designs yet. A design is one part: its references, spec, conversation and every version.
studio.empty_title: Start from a sentence or a picture
studio.empty_hint: Create a design and tell the AI what part you want.
studio.demo_note: Demo mode: the AI replies are canned (two edits and one answer), but scripts run on the real local engine.
studio.delete_confirm: The conversation and versions of this design will no longer be shown (model files stay in the library).
studio.viewer_empty_hint: Tell the AI what you want, on the right
studio.params_empty: Once a model exists its adjustable parameters appear here: change a number to rebuild, no AI, no cost.
studio.chat_empty_title: What part do you want to make?
studio.chat_empty_hint: Describe the purpose and rough size; product shots, photos or sketches help. I will draft a spec for you to confirm, then build it — after that, just tell me what to change.
studio.composer_new_placeholder: e.g. a desk-edge cable clip, 60 mm long, three slots that hold a 5 mm cable
studio.composer_edit_placeholder: Say what to change: widen the slots to 8 mm / add an M3 hole here / does this need supports? (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
studio.pick_hint: Turn on, then click the model to tell the AI "I mean here"
studio.suggest_chamfer: Add a small chamfer to the bottom edge against elephant foot
studio.suggest_support: Does this need supports to print?
studio.spec_hint: Tell me what is off ("make it 80 long"), or press "Edit spec" to change it item by item.
studio.built_default: The model has been generated from the spec.
studio.load_failed_code: Put the last draft into the editor
studio.event_manual: Code edited by hand and run
